fights.title: Bone Knight + Bone Bishop
fights.summary: Two skeletons: dodge rings and lines, stop Ossify, hit the Knight from behind.

killOrder.text: Bone Bishop first; its ring and line casts are harder to dodge

mechanics.name: Death Spiral
mechanics.tell: Bishop casts a donut (4-40y) around itself
mechanics.do: Stand right under the Bishop

mechanics.name: Tumulus
mechanics.tell: Knight casts a 6y circle on itself
mechanics.do: Step out of the Knight's circle

mechanics.name: Black Eruption
mechanics.tell: 5y circle, then 4 lines of circles march outward
mechanics.do: Wait out the first bursts, then step into the origin

mechanics.name: Ancient Aero
mechanics.tell: Bishop fires an 8y-wide line; leaves Windburn
mechanics.do: Step out of the line

mechanics.name: Forward Guard
mechanics.tell: Knight raises a shield that blocks hits from the front
mechanics.do: Snarl so it faces the pet, then hit it from behind

mechanics.name: Ossify

hits.name: Skull Splinter
hits.tell: Knight single-target hard hit
hits.do: Let the pet take it, or Parting Blow 1-2 s before it lands

Scouring Ash (Ashkin) or Ultrasonics (bat) for Windburn when convenient

unknown: Black Eruption caster: IV and BMR say Bishop; NT and CHR say Knight

fights.title: Arch Demon Piece
fights.summary: Pure movement fight; mechanics layer up the longer it lives, so burn it down.

mechanics.name: Abyssal Charge
mechanics.tell: Lances appear and fire 4y-wide lines at you, 2-3 times
mechanics.do: Sidestep each line; the lances are not worth attacking

mechanics.name: Dismember
mechanics.tell: Five 8y-wide lanes fire one after another
mechanics.do: Step into the lane that just fired

mechanics.name: Abyssal Transfixion
mechanics.tell: Sword markers drop delayed circles, also under your feet
mechanics.do: Keep moving so the follow-up stab misses

mechanics.name: Abyssal Swing
mechanics.tell: Axe swing covers the front half
mechanics.do: Stand in the rear half; the boundary is its centerline

fights.title: Piscodemon Piece
fights.summary: Dispel Clear Mind before Arcane Blast; dodge marching ice, the cross and the donut.

mechanics.name: Void Blizzard III
mechanics.tell: Ice marks the starts; 2 sets of 5y bursts march across
mechanics.do: Wait in set 2's lane, step into set 1's after it passes

mechanics.name: Clear Mind
mechanics.tell: Self buff: Damage Up
mechanics.do: Dispel it: Quelling Wave, Bloodcurdling Caw or Fang of Water

mechanics.name: Void Flare Star
mechanics.tell: Proximity blast from a marked point
mechanics.do: Get as far from the point as you can

mechanics.name: Void Thunder III
mechanics.tell: Cross AoE with 10y-wide arms
mechanics.do: Stand on a diagonal

mechanics.name: Void Aero III
mechanics.tell: Donut; safe only right under the boss
mechanics.do: Go under the boss

hits.name: Arcane Blast
hits.tell: Unavoidable room-wide; much bigger while Clear Mind is up
hits.do: Dispel Clear Mind first, else mitigate (Water Wall, Beastskin)

counters.what: Clear Mind (Damage Up on the Piscodemon)

bring.text: A dispel for Clear Mind: Quelling Wave (Wavekin), Bloodcurdling Caw (vulture) or Fang of Water

fights.title: Banemite Piece + Miteling Piece
fights.summary: Poison tankbuster, expanding rings and a web; AoE the Mitelings when they spawn.

mechanics.name: Bedrock Uplift
mechanics.tell: 6y circle at center, then rings expand out to 24y
mechanics.do: Step into the first area right after it pops

mechanics.name: Venom Web
mechanics.tell: 9y circles drop at center, then around the edge in order
mechanics.do: Move into spots that already went off

mechanics.name: Miteling spawn

mechanics.do: AoE them; hold an AoE Tempered Release for this

mechanics.name: Silkscreen
mechanics.tell: Miteling line AoE, 4y wide, Heavy
mechanics.do: Step out of the line; Heavy can't be cleansed

Angel Robe prevents the poison
Skip poison beasts: the Banemite resists poison

fights.title: Ogre Piece + Wisp Piece + Great Wisp Piece

fights.title: Wyvern Piece

mechanics.name: Liquid Hell

Fire damage (their weakness); a fire-resistance-down release helps

mechanics.name: Grounding Jolt
mechanics.tell: Absorbing hand = 20y circle, other hand = 6y circle
mechanics.do: Track which hand absorbed; the boss turns

mechanics.name: Missiles
mechanics.tell: 4y-wide lines that track you
mechanics.do: Move after they lock on

mechanics.name: Thermobaric Charge
mechanics.tell: Marker on the enmity target; 40y knockback from the drop
mechanics.do: Drop it at a corner or edge

mechanics.name: Diffusion Ray
mechanics.tell: 120-degree frontal cone
mechanics.do: Get out of its front

mechanics.name: Spinner-rook Pieces
mechanics.tell: At ~50-60% rooks spawn; Durga invulnerable; gauge fills
mechanics.do: Swap and burst the rooks: Parting Blows, fangs

hits.name: Atomic Ray
hits.tell: Room-wide; heavier the fuller the gauge; pet cover fails
hits.do: Drake TR, Scaleskin or Beastskin, potion; keep HP high

bring.text: Flame Shield gear (fire absorb) for Atomic Ray

unknown: Rook phase trigger: ~50% (AS) vs ~60% (LSB)
Thermobaric Charge drop spot: BMR says a corner, guides say the edge

fights.title: Medusa Piece + Lamia Piece + Cyclops Piece
fights.summary: Interrupt Raise, never get petrified; aim the petrify cone at Cyclopes, not Lamias.

killOrder.text: Both Lamias evenly (interrupt Raise), then petrified Cyclopes

mechanics.name: Summon
mechanics.tell: 2 Lamias; later 4 Cyclopes
mechanics.do: Kill both Lamias evenly

mechanics.name: Raise
mechanics.tell: A Lamia revives the dead one
mechanics.do: Interrupt it or burst the caster

mechanics.name: Petrifying Regard
mechanics.tell: Petrify cone baited on you; petrified = dead
mechanics.do: Aim it away from Lamias and onto Cyclopes

mechanics.name: Petrifying Passion
mechanics.tell: 5 rotating petrify cones, 30 degrees apart
mechanics.do: Stay out of every cone; aim them at Cyclopes

mechanics.name: Impassion
mechanics.tell: Medusa self Damage Up
mechanics.do: Dispel it if you can

mechanics.name: Terrorizing Miasma
mechanics.tell: Lamia circle, Hysteria
mechanics.do: Step out

mechanics.name: Constricting Evisceration
mechanics.tell: Blade combo: 5-60y donut, 6y circle, narrow cones
mechanics.do: Watch each telegraph and move in or out

mechanics.name: 1000-tonze Swing
mechanics.tell: Cyclops 20y circles covering the arena
mechanics.do: Petrify the Cyclopes with the cone to stop it

mechanics.name: Glower
mechanics.tell: Cyclops 3y-wide line, Paralysis
mechanics.do: Step out of the line

mechanics.name: Petrified Cyclops
mechanics.tell: Petrified Cyclopes die to one physical hit
mechanics.do: Hit them right away

counters.what: Impassion Damage Up (panel says not dispellable)

unknown: Impassion: AS says dispellable; the panel says it is not
AS is the only guide for this random space

fights.title: Chimera Piece
fights.summary: Pick in or out from the roar, then the safe angle from the breathing head; cleanse poison.

mechanics.name: The Ram's Roar
mechanics.tell: Ice: 12y circle, Frostbite
mechanics.do: Get out

mechanics.name: The Dragon's Roar
mechanics.tell: Lightning: donut, Electrocution
mechanics.do: Hug the boss

mechanics.name: Head breaths
mechanics.tell: 240-degree breath from the lion, goat or dragon head
mechanics.do: Lion: rear safe. Goat: front-left. Dragon: front-right

mechanics.name: Rushing Roar
mechanics.tell: Tether to the enmity target, a charge, then a breath
mechanics.do: Get far until the tether changes, then dodge the breath

mechanics.name: The Ram's Keeper
mechanics.tell: Marker; leaves an 18y freezing puddle
mechanics.do: Drop it at the edge; keep the boss central

mechanics.name: Cacophony
mechanics.tell: Slow chasing lightning orb, Paralysis
mechanics.do: Kite it away

mechanics.name: Toxic Tantrum
mechanics.tell: Room-wide hit plus poison
mechanics.do: Cleanse with Scouring Ash

counters.what: Frostbite or Electrocution from the roars

unknown: Rushing Roar and The Ram's Keeper matched to guide descriptions by shape and timing

fights.title: Sphinx Piece
fights.summary: Burst to skip riddles; stand on a number matching your buff; pick the named beast.

mechanics.name: Banish
mechanics.tell: Head low = 18y circle; head raised = donut; leap = half
mechanics.do: Circle: out. Donut: in. Half: go to the other side

mechanics.name: Numeric Riddle
mechanics.tell: Tiles 1-9; you get All Odds, Evens, Three or Primes
mechanics.do: Stand on a matching tile; pick a northern one

mechanics.name: Mnemonic Riddle
mechanics.tell: Dodo, Opo-opo, Puk and Pugil turn into Mandragoras
mechanics.do: Track the named kin: cloud Dodo, scale Puk, beast Opo-opo, wave Pugil

mechanics.name: Riddle result
mechanics.tell: Right = Damage Up for you; wrong = 4 adds
mechanics.do: AoE the adds if you miss

mechanics.name: Lost Hope
mechanics.tell: Temporary Misdirection on you
mechanics.do: Move carefully; your movement is misdirected

bring.text: Slashing damage (its weakness) for the whole fight

fights.title: Gigantis Piece + Cyclops Piece + Congealed Lightning + Congealed Kindling
fights.summary: Interrupt Rupture and Camaraderie; aim Smashing Stamp through a gel; read the club pose.

killOrder.text: Cyclops, then the gel you are not crushing, then small gels and the boss

mechanics.name: Gigantic Rage
mechanics.tell: Club pose picks the shape: 15y circle or 180-degree cone
mechanics.do: Read the pose; get out or go to the safe half

mechanics.name: Smashing Stamp
mechanics.tell: Marker; 8y-wide line from the boss to you, Knockdown
mechanics.do: Aim the line through a gel of the other element

mechanics.name: Club element
mechanics.tell: Lightning club: tower under you; fire club: 6y AoE
mechanics.do: Lightning: stay in the tower. Fire: move out

mechanics.name: Rupture
mechanics.tell: Gel room-wide hit plus Damage Down
mechanics.do: Interrupt with Soul Crush, else kill the gel

mechanics.name: Camaraderie
mechanics.tell: Cyclops heals the boss 5% if it finishes
mechanics.do: Interrupt it

mechanics.name: Glower
mechanics.tell: Cyclops 6y-wide line, Paralysis
mechanics.do: Step out of the line

bring.text: Soul Crush (Soulkin borrow) for Rupture; near-mandatory

unknown: Camaraderie: AS says dispel; panel and BMR say interrupt
Club pose descriptions differ between AS and LSB

fights.title: Swordsmog Piece + Mogbreaker Piece + Kinged Kupocurer + Kinged Kupocaster + Kupocurer Piece + Kupocaster Piece + Kinged Swordsmog + Melomog Piece + Mogmugger Piece
fights.summary: Kill the Mogmugger before it flees; killing the Kinged Swordsmog ends the fight.

killOrder.text: Mogmugger, Melomogs, the casting Kinged healer or caster, then Kinged Swordsmog

mechanics.name: Swordsmog on standby
mechanics.tell: The standby Swordsmog only auto-attacks
mechanics.do: Kill it at once

mechanics.name: Moogle Tempest
mechanics.tell: Circle around a wave moogle
mechanics.do: Step out

mechanics.name: 100-kuponze Swipe
mechanics.tell: Frontal cone
mechanics.do: Stay out of its front

mechanics.name: Pom Holy
mechanics.tell: The triangle between 3 moogles is the danger zone
mechanics.do: Stay outside the triangle

mechanics.name: Pom Meteorain
mechanics.tell: Ground circles
mechanics.do: Step out

mechanics.name: Pom Flood / Pom Flare
mechanics.tell: Room-wide hit, water or fire resist down
mechanics.do: Kill the role that has two members first

mechanics.name: Daylight Pommery
mechanics.tell: Mogmugger steals coins, then flees
mechanics.do: Kill the Mogmugger first

mechanics.name: Moghemian Rhapsody
mechanics.tell: Melomogs give nearby allies Damage Up
mechanics.do: Kill them after the Mogmugger

mechanics.name: Spirit of Pompetition
mechanics.tell: Kinged Swordsmog self Damage Up
mechanics.do: Dispel it

mechanics.name: Mogshield Swipe
mechanics.tell: Kinged Swordsmog frontal
mechanics.do: Stay out of its front

unknown: No BMR module; AS is the only guide
Wave order and AoE sizes are not documented

fights.title: Behemoth Piece + Giant Piece + Lightning Sprite
fights.summary: Reset towers at 2, spread comets, hide behind a comet for Ecliptic Meteor.

mechanics.name: Towers
mechanics.tell: Left and right towers charge through 3 stages
mechanics.do: Touch a tower at 2 to reset it; 3 = stun + room-wide

mechanics.name: Meteor Impact
mechanics.tell: 5 comets placed in sequence
mechanics.do: Spread them; comets too close explode

mechanics.name: Thundercloud
mechanics.tell: A cloud on you adds 2 charges to a tower
mechanics.do: Drop it on a tower, then reset that tower first

mechanics.name: Ecliptic Meteor
mechanics.tell: Room-wide hit
mechanics.do: Hide behind a comet (line of sight)

mechanics.name: Charybdis
mechanics.tell: Behemoth crouching = in; arms raised = out
mechanics.do: Crouching: get close. Arms up: get out

mechanics.name: Grand Sword
mechanics.tell: Giant frontal cone
mechanics.do: Stay out of its front

mechanics.name: Cross Charge
mechanics.tell: Lightning Sprite cross, Paralysis
mechanics.do: Stand off the cross arms

mechanics.name: Meteor
mechanics.tell: Stack shared by you and the pet
mechanics.do: Keep the pet summoned and next to you

unknown: No BMR module; AS is the only guide
Tower, comet and cloud casts have no known IDs

fights.title: King Ahriman Piece + Hapalit Piece + Dirty Eye Piece
fights.summary: Parting Blow the pet before Curtains for Rank 5; clear adds; face per the gaze debuff.

mechanics.name: Curtains for Rank 5
mechanics.tell: Kills only the familiar
mechanics.do: Parting Blow the pet before it resolves; resummon after

mechanics.name: Roulette
mechanics.tell: You are rooted and thrown to a quadrant with an hourglass
mechanics.do: Break the hourglass when the needle is not on you

mechanics.name: Uncast frontal line
mechanics.tell: Strong frontal line with no castbar
mechanics.do: Stay out of its front

mechanics.name: Gaze debuffs
mechanics.tell: Wrath or Grief debuff on you
mechanics.do: Wrath: go behind the boss. Grief: go in front

mechanics.name: Adds
mechanics.tell: While adds are up, King Ahriman is invulnerable
mechanics.do: Clear the adds first

mechanics.name: Mortal Gaze
mechanics.tell: Dirty Eye Doom gaze; you can turn while rooted
mechanics.do: Look away

mechanics.name: Straight Punch
mechanics.tell: Hapalit hits the enmity target, Burns
mechanics.do: Snarl it onto the pet; cleanse Burns

mechanics.name: Stone
mechanics.tell: Dirty Eye hits the enmity target
mechanics.do: Keep it on the pet with Snarl

mechanics.name: Flare
mechanics.tell: Proximity damage on you
mechanics.do: Take it away from the pet

bring.text: Soulreaper's Armor: the only Doom resist

unknown: No BMR module; AS is the only guide

fights.title: Lauda the Spellcleaver + Thanatos Piece
fights.summary: Stronger Guttler: Challenge, pet behind her, 100% paralysis resist, lines off statues.

killOrder.text: Tethered blades first, then a woken Thanatos, then Lauda

mechanics.name: Cleaving auto-attack
mechanics.tell: 120-degree frontal cleave auto
mechanics.do: Challenge; keep the pet away from her front

mechanics.name: Beastly Aura
mechanics.tell: Room-wide 20y knockback on you and the pet
mechanics.do: Stand at the center so you fly to the north/south tiles

mechanics.name: Vanishing Daggers
mechanics.tell: Swords go invisible, then fire 5y lines along their blades
mechanics.do: Read the blade directions and take the safe half

mechanics.name: Gyrocleave
mechanics.tell: 20y-wide line
mechanics.do: Go to the raised side tiles

mechanics.name: Overpowering Point
mechanics.tell: Lines from the boss and 2 swords, all aimed at you
mechanics.do: Keep her central; stand north or south so lines miss statues

mechanics.name: Unseen Force
mechanics.tell: Sword stabs you from front or back; 40y push
mechanics.do: Stand on a north/south tile facing so you fly inward

mechanics.name: Deadly Demesne
mechanics.tell: Cages bind inside; yellow = 12y circle, green = cross
mechanics.do: Stay out of cages; the 2nd cast uses the other colour

mechanics.name: Molten Metal
mechanics.tell: Sword drops where you stood; big blast
mechanics.do: Drop it at one side and run; wait for other AoEs first

mechanics.name: Gluttonous Gutting / Goring
mechanics.tell: Leap: airborne = arena-wide circle; grounded = front half
mechanics.do: Airborne: get far away. Grounded: go behind

mechanics.name: Greater Strength
mechanics.tell: Two blades tether; a 28 s cast ends in a blast or push
mechanics.do: Destroy the tethered blades fast

mechanics.name: Combusting Blades
mechanics.tell: Swords drop 8y circles
mechanics.do: Step out

mechanics.name: Infernal Pain
mechanics.tell: Woken Thanatos Piece room-wide hit
mechanics.do: Kill it with lightning before the cast ends

hits.name: Thunderbolt
hits.tell: 6y-wide line at the enmity target, Paralysis
hits.do: Dodge the first; Snarl the second, then swap the pet

counters.what: Paralysis from Thunderbolt (panel says not cleansable)

bring.text: 100% paralysis resist: Antiparalysis serum, Crimson Ribbon, Genji Gloves or Morel
Beastskin (Beastkin borrow); a paralysis-resist release for Thunderbolt

unknown: Empowered blades: AS says the boss takes Damage Down, LSB says destroy the swords; BMR prioritizes them
Thunderbolt paralysis: panel says not cleansable; guides cleanse it; pre-resist to be safe
